decision_conditions:
The revised drawings are not acceptable as currently submitted. The plans continue to show accommodation as residential on the basis that a previous change of use permission has been approved. However, the approved change of use has not been implemented and therefore does not form part of the existing lawful situation on site.
The applicant must either:
Amend the existing plans to show the building as it currently exists and is lawfully used; or amend the proposal and description of development so that they include all works necessary to facilitate the proposed change of use and accurately reflect the development being applied for. A note on the drawings referring to a previously approved but unimplemented permission is not sufficient to address this discrepancy.
Please submit revised existing and proposed drawings accordingly.
